evidence: docs/INSTITUTIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md P2-03: `app/src/lib/health/procedures.test.ts` "refuses premises that are not published registered sites, and the education authority cannot license a clinic"; `app/src/lib/permits/cycle3-production.test.ts` "refuses a school registration, a facility licence and a professional registration until a mapping is approved"; `app/src/lib/casework/engine.test.ts` (grant needs "Can sign"; administrator refused)

section_title: How to measure completion for this group
text: The health ministry cannot search unrestricted patient records simply because it administers health facilities.
evidence: docs/INSTITUTIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md P2-04: `app/src/lib/health/procedures.test.ts` "…takes its aggregate capacity return; no patient field exists"; `app/src/app/api/health-regulation/route.test.ts` "takes returns only from the health regulator, refuses anything that is not an aggregate count"; `app/src/apps/ministry-health/health-fields.test.ts` "no source file names one, outside the justified exceptions", "the administrative engine the screens read answers with no patient or clinical field" (step I0.1); `app/src/apps/ministry-health/health-surfaces.test.ts` "every health group of the ministry system console, in demo, in production and
missing: The health registers, the whole health application and the ministry system console's health groups (`components/features/SubsystemConsole.tsx`: workforce and licensing desk, health service access; every group rendered and scanned) are proven to hold and show no patient or clinical field. There is no record anyone could search, so the item is still proven only by absence: no access rule over a health record is tested because none exists.

section_title: How to measure completion for this group
text: A school officer cannot access unrelated schools’ identifiable student records without an approved purpose and scope.
evidence: docs/INSTITUTIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md P2-05: `app/src/app/api/education/route.test.ts` "refuses reads outside the education authority, needs a purpose from auditors, and logs every read and refusal"; `app/src/lib/education/procedures.test.ts`
missing: By rule there is no student record system (aggregates only). That makes the item largely not applicable. No test scopes a school officer to their own school, and nothing asserts that returns stay aggregate-only.

section_title: How to measure completion for this group
text: An immigration decision retains its legal basis, evidence, reasons, notices and review history.
evidence: docs/INSTITUTIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md P2-06: `app/src/lib/immigration/procedures.test.ts` "runs a visa to a verifiable document with four eyes, then extends and revokes it" (evidence documents, reasons, notice before revocation); `app/src/lib/casework/engine.test.ts` "decides with four eyes, seals the decision with the law in force, and opens the appeal window"; `app/src/lib/records/decisions.test.ts` "needs reasons and the deciding official; a correction supersedes"
missing: Legal basis, evidence, reasons and notice are proven. The review/appeal history is not: the appeal window opens, but no test runs an immigration review and checks that the decision record keeps it.

section_title: How to measure completion for this group
text: A social-benefit calculation can be reproduced from its recorded inputs and versioned rules.
evidence: docs/INSTITUTIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md P2-07: `app/src/lib/law/rules.test.ts` "refuses to calculate until a tested rule citing the law is approved by a second official"; `app/src/lib/permits/decisions.test.ts` "seals the rule version an assessment calculated with"
missing: The mechanism for reproducible calculation is proven, but there is no social-benefit procedure or test that re-runs a benefit from recorded inputs.

section_title: How to measure completion for this group

missing: No test makes an exchange source unavailable during a case and asserts that the decision is held as pending rather than adverse.
